Keywords: Timber work and river traffic at Bryansk
RagShortTexts: Bryansk links settlements through the Desna and forest roads, carrying timber and food.
Forest routes need guides and repairs; princely power also depends on local supplies.

Variants.Content: Bryansk's forest roads and the Desna connect scattered settlements carrying timber, food and people. Woods conceal movement but separate messengers and wagons. A local leader assembling followers needs route knowledge, shelter and supplies. One strongpoint cannot watch every branch of the network.

Timber and food carriage around Bryansk consume human and animal effort, especially in mud. Taking a guide away removes help at home. Shared loads save transport if households agree on watches, recovery of broken carts and returning in time for fieldwork.
